subject: Client Welcome Week: Availability, Agenda & Meeting Links
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@novaplace.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client Welcome Week: Availability, Agenda & Meeting Links

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for signing the SOW — excited to get Novaplace into a production-ready onboarding flow. We usually run a "Welcome Week" (3 short sessions over the first week) to align stakeholders, surface integration checkpoints, and confirm go/no-go criteria. To make scheduling painless, can you confirm Availabilities for the window below?

Proposed window (PST):
- Mon Nov 9: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 11: 09:30–10:30 or 13:30–14:30
- Fri Nov 13: 11:00–11:45 (wrap / next steps)

Core attendees we recommend:
- Novaplace: Product lead (1), IT/security lead (1), Integration engineer (1)
- Redwood: Customer Success Manager (Marissa Cole), Implementation PM (Karthik Iyer), Solutions Engineer (me)

Attached is a draft agenda and a short readiness checklist (implementation dependencies highlighted). If you prefer a different cadence (single half-day workshop vs. spread), let me know.

Once you confirm a time that works for stakeholders, I’ll send calendar invites with Zoom and shared docs.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: Welcome_Week_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF), Implementation_Readiness_Checklist.xlsx (Excel)

Tom: can you confirm the integration engineer who will own the workstream? If we can lock Wed 11/11 09:30 for session 1 (alignment + network/access), we should be able to cover the remainder across the week as proposed.

— Sarah

I’ll draft calendar invites once Sean confirms the exact attendee list and time.
